summary: Retested Runtime-mode frontend fixes. All previously-failing issues from iteration_1 are resolved: no 'object is not extensible' / unhandled-rejection errors, no duplicate React key warnings, live tiles update within 500ms, LINKED indicator shows, serial terminal scrolls, format toggle (JSON<->MSGPACK/BIN) works, stop/restart is clean, and Add Server dialog opens without Radix aria-describedby warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Runtime mode appears to auto-start transmission on view entry (streaming was already active on fresh page load with 274.8s uptime observed). If intentional, document; if not, expose a state to only start on explicit user action.

KPI labels 'Frames TX' and 'Data Rate' were not matched by simple regex in body text (likely due to non-breaking spaces / DOM structure). Values were confirmed visually in screenshot (3,836 frames, 1.4 KB/s) - consider adding data-testid to KPI values for future automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixes verified on live URL. 10 benign console warnings observed (unclassified, non-error, non-duplicate-key). Recommend adding data-testid to KPI values (frames-tx, data-rate, uptime) for more robust future assertions.
